items.title: Launcher 1.0.33 is available
items.body:
Dauntless Unbroken Launcher 1.0.33 for Windows and Linux. 

Windows:
- Installer: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-Setup.exe`
- Portable: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.33-win32-x64.zip`

Linux x86_64:
- Universal AppImage: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.33-linux-x86_64.AppImage`
- Debian/Ubuntu/Mint/Pop!_OS: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.33-linux-amd64.deb`
- Fedora/openSUSE/RHEL-family: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.33-linux-x86_64.rpm`
- Portable ZIP: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.33-linux-x64.zip`
- Portable tar.gz: `DauntlessUnbrokenLauncher-1.0.33-linux-x64.tar.gz`

Linux runs the pinned Windows game client through an installed Proton or Wine runtime. The launcher
auto-detects Steam Proton, Proton-GE, system Wine and Lutris Wine; no game files are bundled.

- Check your download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or check where it was built with
  `gh attestation verify <file> --repo Vvoidddd/dauntless-unbroken`.

The launcher is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm
(More info, then Run anyway). If Windows only offers "Don't run", check the file's SHA-256
against `SHA256SUMS.txt` from this release (`Get-FileHash <file>` in PowerShell; letter
case does not matter; if they differ, delete the file), then unblock it: right-click the
file > Properties > Unblock, or `Unblock-File <file>` in PowerShell. Installed Windows
launchers update themselves; Linux users update through their package format or a newer release.

Free software under the GNU AGPL-3.0. No game files are included: the launcher downloads
them from your host's server and checks every file against the list built into it.

items.title: Launcher 1.0.30 is available
items.body:
## Launcher 1.0.30 changes

- Saved accounts for shared PCs: keep multiple player accounts and switch without re-importing keys.
- Open Settings → Account → Saved accounts to import each existing account once. Your current account is saved automatically.
- Use the top-right account menu for quick switching. Close the game before switching; a rejected key leaves the working account selected.
- Keys stay encrypted on this PC. Removing a saved sign-in preserves server progress and exported backups.
- One game installation is shared. Online progress and online playtime follow the selected account; the offline save remains separate.
